description: This file defines classes for redirecting console output streams, including StandardOut, StandardError, and their singleton wrappers ConsoleStandardOut and ConsoleStandardError, within the Thunder::Messaging namespace.

classes.name: StandardOut
classes.description: Handles output to standard output stream, sending messages if enabled.

classes.name: StandardError
classes.description: Handles output to standard error stream, sending messages if enabled.

classes.name: ConsoleStandardOut
classes.description: Singleton wrapper for redirecting console standard output.

classes.name: ConsoleStandardError
classes.description: Singleton wrapper for redirecting console standard error.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs a message buffer of specified length to the respective stream if enabled.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of ConsoleStandardOut or ConsoleStandardError.
